==============================================================================

Used in: the GESIS episode reconstruction rule (`red_start_stop` port) in
rust/chronicle_app_usage_matcher/src/lib.rs, compiled into the WebAssembly
runtime.

        doi:10.71627/How-to-work-with-Android-App-Logging-Data.1
